**Step 1 — Scene:** A small mixed-leaf salad with walnuts and dark olives, lightly glossy with dressing.

**Step 2 — Vessel:** An oval, shallow plate, approximately 30 × 22 cm. Its area is roughly equivalent to a 26 cm round plate: 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

**Steps 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight and energy:** Area shares below are allocated without double-counting overlapping ingredients.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed leafy greens, including rocket | 43% | 228 cm² × 1.7 cm = 388 ml | 0.12 g/ml | 47 g | 25 | 12 kcal |
| Black olives | 5% | 27 cm² × 1.3 cm = 35 ml | 0.7 g/ml | 24 g | 115 | 28 kcal |
| Walnut pieces | 3% | 16 cm² × 1 cm = 16 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 10 g | 654 | 65 kcal |
| Oil-based dressing, estimated from light sheen | Overlay | Approximately 4 ml | ~1 g/ml | 4 g | 880 | 35 kcal |

**Area check:** 43% + 5% + 3% = **51%** of the plate covered. Dressing overlaps the salad rather than occupying additional plate area.

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **85 g and 140 kcal** is plausible for this loose, modest salad. The main uncertainties are whether the dark pieces are olives and how much oil is present; the leaves themselves contribute little energy.
